name: mOS 1.0 Amber (0.6.2)
notes: New mOS password pop-up when an app or update needs your password
New Start button: the Amber mOS logo, filling your icon shape
Open apps show their name next to the icon on the taskbar (Settings > Taskbar to turn off)
Files is laid out like Windows 11 File Explorer, and double-click opens things
No more second Settings: the KDE apps mOS replaces are hidden from Start and search
